items.details: Keep separate manual saves before missable Novigrad quests and political preparations, before The Isle of Mists, before Blood on the Battlefield, and before the later Ciri choices. Keep another before Whatsoever a Man Soweth and before The Night of Long Fangs. Do not overwrite these slots while pursuing another ending. This game has no chapter-select system that can reconstruct earlier quest decisions: load a suitable earlier manual save or start another campaign. A save after a failed prerequisite cannot restore that route. Xplore checkmarks record guide coverage across replays, not independent playthroughs or game saves; mark an ending only after seeing it. Main A/B/C, HoS A/B and BaW A/B/C are neutral labels whose actual outcomes are explained only in Details.

items.details: Before finishing Whatsoever a Man Soweth, follow the optional Shani lead and visit Professor Shakeslock at the Oxenfurt Academy before going to the temple meeting. Learn his information and choose to help Olgierd by challenging O'Dimm. In the timed riddle world, follow the route toward the mansion, pass the false mirrors and reach the dry fountain. items.details: Choose Damien's route to find Syanna during The Night of Long Fangs. Read every court-governess journal entry with Regis before entering the fairy-tale world. During Beyond Hill and Dale, listen to Syanna's background instead of dismissing it and obtain her ribbon from the Little Flint Girl by winning Gwent or paying for it before leaving. The ribbon protects her at Tesham Mutna; defeat Dettlaff. In Pomp and Strange Circumstance, investigate the intended fifth victim with Regis through the bootblack and poorhouse. Main A: Ciri follows the witcher path; use supportive choices and skip Emhyr.

BaW A: fairy tales, ribbon, investigation and reconciliation keep both sisters alive.

HoS means Hearts of Stone; BaW means Blood and Wine. Open the route-specific decision steps in Details for the complete dialogue, prerequisite and replay instructions. The three letters form one compatible combination; other political/romance/visitor variations are outside these eighteen combinations.

Keep another before Whatsoever a Man Soweth and before The Night of Long Fangs. Do not overwrite these slots while pursuing another ending. This game has no chapter-select system that can reconstruct earlier quest decisions: load a suitable earlier manual save or start another campaign. summary_i18n.en: Prepare your supplies and choose manageable objectives.

guides.body:

3. Explore White Orchard at a comfortable pace, collect useful ingredients and learn available formulas. Leave a skull-marked opponent for later instead of treating every nearby marker as an immediate obligation.

4. Make a separate manual save before leaving a region or accepting a major warning. Return here for a system explanation; use Walkthrough for the actual mission sequence.

summary_i18n.en: Use the journal, map and Witcher Senses when a route is unclear.

guides.body:
1. Open the quest journal and select the exact quest you want to track. Read its current objective, not only the quest title. A main quest can pause while another lead or subquest must be completed.

2. Open the map and check the objective's region and elevation. A marker above or below you may require stairs, a cave entrance or another floor rather than a direct line across the terrain.

3. At the search area, use Witcher Senses and examine highlighted clues. Follow tracks or scents until the objective updates; merely walking over a clue may not count.

4. If the quest requests a letter, book or item, inspect/read it in the inventory. Return to Walkthrough afterward; browsing Guides leaves your checklist completions unchanged.

guides.title: Defend before committing to an attack

title_i18n.en: Defend before committing to an attack
title_i18n.pt: Defender antes de iniciar um ataque

guides.summary: Handle groups, openings and dangerous enemy levels.

summary_i18n.en: Handle groups, openings and dangerous enemy levels.
summary_i18n.pt: Lide com grupos, aberturas e níveis perigosos.

guides.body:
1. Against a new enemy, observe one attack before answering. Dodge to its side, land a short sequence and move away before its next retaliation. Long button-mashing strings often turn a safe opening into damage.

2. Parry and counter suitable human melee attacks; do not assume the same response stops every monster, heavy swing or charge. Dodge or roll out of attacks that overwhelm your guard.

3. Against groups, keep enemies in front of you and avoid being surrounded. Quen can absorb a mistake, but it is not permission to ignore the next attack.

4. If damage feels unreasonable, check enemy level, sword type, durability, healing supplies and active skills. Retreating to a suitable quest is usually more useful than repeatedly fighting a much stronger enemy without preparation.

summary_i18n.en: Choose healing and understand what meditation does.

guides.body:
1. Equip an available healing item in a consumable slot and check its actual tooltip. Food, Swallow and later healing formulas have different recovery behavior; do not assume every item is instant full healing. Use the item before another hit becomes fatal.

3. Meditation restores health on the lower two difficulty settings. It does not restore health on Blood and Broken Bones or Death March. On those settings, use your healing supplies and defensive play. Meditation can still refill crafted consumables if suitable strong alcohol is available.

4. If healing seems ineffective, inspect toxicity, active effects, remaining charges and the selected consumable. Do not lower a Death March trophy run merely to heal by meditation.

guides.summary: Craft a formula once, then restore its charges.

summary_i18n.en: Craft a formula once, then restore its charges.

guides.body:

2. Once crafted, potions, decoctions and bombs use charges. Outside combat, meditate with suitable strong alcohol such as Alcohest or Dwarven Spirit in your inventory to replenish spent charges. 3. If nothing refills, check that the item was actually crafted, that the meditation completed and that you carry refill alcohol rather than only ordinary food/drink.

4. An Enhanced or Superior formula is a separate upgrade with its own ingredients. Refilling the basic version does not automatically upgrade it. Health restoration follows your difficulty rules and is separate from restocking.

Outside danger, let appropriate effects expire or meditate and inspect the result before trying another combination. If health continues dropping, check the toxicity bar and effect icons before assuming the enemy is still hitting you. Keep the recipe and refill process separate from your safe drinking limit.

guides.body:

title_i18n.pt: Viagens, mergulho e ameaças na água

summary_i18n.en: Find entrances and use the correct underwater tool.

guides.body:

guides.title: Understand a Gwent match
guides.summary: Learn rounds, passing and why saving cards matters.

summary_i18n.en: Learn rounds, passing and why saving cards matters.
summary_i18n.pt: Entenda rodadas, passar e por que economizar cartas importa.

guides.body:
Gwent inside The Witcher 3 is not the separate online Gwent game. You normally need to win two rounds. Your starting hand must serve the match; you do not receive a complete new hand at every round. Faction and card abilities can change specific draws or tie rules.

Play a card, use an available ability or pass according to the prompts. Passing ends your participation in that round, not merely one turn: the opponent may keep playing before also passing. Check both scores and remaining cards before committing.

If winning a round would consume almost every good card, consider conceding it and preserving enough strength for the next two. Conversely, once the opponent passes, use only enough resources to secure the result you need. Read hero, weather and special-card exceptions before assuming a familiar effect applies to every unit.

guides.title: Improve a weak Gwent deck

title_i18n.pt: Melhorar um baralho fraco de Gwent

guides.summary: Use a legal, focused deck rather than every card you own.

summary_i18n.en: Use a legal, focused deck rather than every card you own.
summary_i18n.pt: Monte um baralho válido e focado, sem colocar todas as cartas.

guides.body:
Open Gwent Deck and select your faction. Keep at least the required twenty-two unit cards; special cards do not replace that minimum. Owning a card and placing it in the active deck are separate actions, and faction restrictions still apply.

Replace weak units as you obtain stronger ones instead of automatically enlarging the deck. A smaller focused legal deck makes its useful combinations easier to draw. Keep special cards that support that plan, not every weather card just because it is available.

Read spies, medics, decoys, tight-bond and leader abilities. Practise one combination against an ordinary opponent before entering a tournament. Inspect the opponent's faction and reconsider weather that also hurts your own rows. You can lower Gwent's separate difficulty without lowering the base campaign's Death March setting.

guides.summary: Track purchases, named opponents and tournament saves.

summary_i18n.en: Track purchases, named opponents and tournament saves.
summary_i18n.pt: Acompanhe compras, oponentes específicos e salvamentos de torneios.

guides.body:
Buy missing cards from merchants and innkeepers, challenge eligible ordinary players for their first card reward and follow the named Gwent quest chains. Repeatedly beating the same person does not produce an endless stream of unique collection cards.

Use A Miraculous Guide to Gwent and the Collect 'Em All counters to narrow what remains. Protect limited opportunities: save before Triss's masquerade and win all three garden matches before leaving; choose cards as the reward in A Dangerous Game. Save before High Stakes and reload a lost match before continuing if pursuing its complete tournament win and unique rewards.

These are acquisition warnings, not ending spoilers. The Blood and Wine Skellige deck has its own collection quest and is not an extra requirement for the base Card Collector trophy. Consult the specific walkthrough task for the relevant quest rather than treating this guide as an individual location list.

guides.title: Plan the base game and both expansions

title_i18n.en: Plan the base game and both expansions
title_i18n.pt: Planejar o jogo-base e as duas expansões

guides.summary: Choose a manageable order and understand standalone starts.

summary_i18n.en: Choose a manageable order and understand standalone starts.
summary_i18n.pt: Escolha uma ordem acessível e entenda inícios independentes.

guides.body:
For a first complete run, a straightforward plan is the base story, then Hearts of Stone, then Blood and Wine. This is a practical recommendation, not a requirement that every quest must follow that order. The expansions can become available earlier; compare the displayed recommended levels before starting their encounters.

Use your existing campaign if you want to carry its equipment and decisions into the expansions. A standalone expansion start supplies a prepared character and treats the base story as completed; it does not reconstruct all the personal choices of a campaign you never played.

Keep a manual save before a long expansion quest or warning. Blood and Wine has side-content cutoffs before Capture the Castle and a later branching finale. The walkthrough's route Details explain actual outcomes; this general guide deliberately does not reveal them.

guides.title: Understand Blood and Wine mutations

title_i18n.pt: Entender as mutações de Blood and Wine

guides.summary: Separate expansion research from ordinary skills and mutagens.

summary_i18n.en: Separate expansion research from ordinary skills and mutagens.
summary_i18n.pt: Separe pesquisa da expansão, habilidades e mutagênicos comuns.

guides.body:
In Toussaint, follow the delivered research letter and the Turn and Face the Strange quest to unlock the mutation system. This is optional character development, not a hidden requirement to finish the base story. Keep a save before spending a large reserve of points and mutagens.

After unlocking it, inspect each research cost, prerequisite and the currently selected mutation. Researching an option and activating its benefit are not the same thing. Additional slots and color restrictions depend on the research shown by the current interface; do not assume every skill immediately fits every new slot.

Choose a mutation that supports your sword, Sign or alchemy plan, then test the displayed effects. Ordinary colored mutagens, monster-specific alchemy ingredients and researched mutations are different resources/systems. Potion of Clearance is not the dedicated reset for this research; inspect Potion of Restoration if you intend to reverse mutation spending.

guides.title: When a quest seems stuck
guides.summary: Check the objective before reloading or abandoning a quest.

summary_i18n.en: Check the objective before reloading or abandoning a quest.
summary_i18n.pt: Confira o objetivo antes de recarregar ou abandonar uma missão.

guides.body:
1. Re-select the quest and read its current objective. Check the correct region, floor, time of day and any required item, clue or companion. Read quest documents rather than only looting them.

2. Leave combat and finish pending dialogue. If the objective asks you to wait, use the stated interval or time condition. Meditation does not repair a failed prerequisite.

3. Save in a new slot, then try reloading that save if an interaction clearly fails to appear. Keep the earlier working save untouched. Revisit the location through a normal entrance rather than trying to jump through its geometry.

4. If the journal explicitly says Failed, consult the task's Details for a cutoff or decision condition. Recover from an earlier suitable save when necessary. Do not mark a blocked quest completed in Xplore merely to remove it from the list; checkmarks do not change the game.
